references.text: The Lord's Spirit came upon Gideon, and he blew the trumpet. Verse 35 continues by describing how Gideon gathered the tribes after the Spirit came upon him.
The same tribes that were called together in 6:35 (Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh) were again assembled to pursue the Midianites.
The mustering of Israel's tribes, including Manasseh, Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, which was also summoned by Gideon.
Deborah and Barak also gathered Zebulun and Naphtali for battle, similar to Gideon's gathering of the tribes.
Saul also sent messengers throughout all Israel to gather the people for battle, in the same way that Gideon sent messengers.
Ehud also blew the trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim to gather the Israelites for battle, similar to Gideon's call to the tribes.
